question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **"preserving".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• If we refer to the line This is a matter of great hope and relief for those who understand the value of (4) ______ wildlife and the environment.
 
• The context of the comprehension is showing the positive aspects of nature
 
• **Retaining:- **serving to hold an object in place
 
• **Preserving:- **maintain (something) in its original or existing state
 
• **Storing:- **keep or accumulate (something) for future use
 
• **Maintaining means to **cause or enable (a condition or situation) to continue​
 
• Hence, the correct answer is option no 3.

So the complete passage- *The tiger census has revealed that India's big cat count has (1) shot up in the last few years. This is a (2) matter of great hope and relief for (3) those who understand the value of (4) preserving wildlife and the environment. This success is the (5) reward of collective efforts of the government and the environmentalists.*
